components.name: Mobile Client
components.purpose: Publishes content and requests feed pages and media.

components.name: API Gateway
components.purpose: Authenticates operations and routes metadata requests.

components.name: User Service
components.purpose: Owns profiles, privacy settings and follow relationships.

components.name: Post Service
components.purpose: Publishes versioned posts after durable media upload and owns access-checked post/engagement metadata.

components.name: Feed Service
components.purpose: Builds and serves eligible follower feed references.

components.name: Media Service
components.purpose: Validates uploads and produces photo/video derivatives.

components.name: Database
components.purpose: Durable posts, follows, likes, comments and visibility versions.

components.name: Object Storage
components.purpose: Stores original and derived media assets.

components.name: Event Queue
components.purpose: Buffers media and fanout work with replayable event IDs.

components.name: Feed Cache
components.purpose: Stores bounded feed references; visibility remains authoritative elsewhere.

components.name: CDN
components.purpose: Delivers public media or authorized private assets to clients.

components.name: Ranking Service
components.purpose: Optional ranking beyond a chronological baseline.

tradeoffs.guidance: Credit any strategy that handles the stated load and high-degree accounts.
A machine-learning system is not required.

alternatives: Publish an original and add derivatives later
tradeoffs.guidance: Prevent broken references and define latency versus quality.

dataModel.notes: Index author plus ordering key; filter current visibility.
Maintain both follower and following access paths.
Bound the cache; entries are references, not permission grants.
Unique keys make retried likes idempotent.
Use a stable cursor and access/deletion checks; do not expose comments on a post the reader cannot access.

flows.name: Publish
steps: Authorize an upload and store the media durably
Publish post metadata and a recoverable fanout event
Workers create derivatives and feed references idempotently
Feed reads filter visibility and return bounded references

flows.name: Media read
steps: Client receives a media manifest from feed metadata
Client fetches the asset from CDN or authorized object storage
CDN serves or retrieves the object without proxying all bytes through the API
